description: Learning-plane benchmark task set (issue #144). Changing a task, a seed, a hidden test, a planned tier, verify.py or meshloop.toml requires a new version and a new baseline. lp-4 supersedes lp-3: verify.py no longer trusts a bare exit code, because the editable code runs in the test process. A Python pass needs the runner's result line carrying a nonce that the tested code cannot read from stdin; a Rust pass needs cargo's summaries adding up to expected_tests. Both check the expected_tests count from task.json.
